text: Jars home, whistles quiet. Somebody under the pool laughed just now. Out loud. On the clock.
All three! That's six weeks of tips. That's a bus ticket home for Housekeeping-4. Here — 110, and the thanks of everyone under the pool.
Sir, we have rules about refusing gratuity. They're the only rules we like.
Management confiscates our tip jars. Policy says gratuity is 'a relationship between the guest and the brand'. There are three jars up on the decks. They are ours.
110 bolts from the staff fund. We passed a hat. Then management confiscated the hat. This is from the SECOND hat.
Silence. Listen to that. Somebody down the row just SAT. On purpose. 100 bolts, and I've put the wet-floor sign out for you.
The Lifeguard Bots don't guard lives. They guard BREAKS. Sit down for nine seconds and one blows a whistle in your audio port.
100 bolts. And if anyone asks, you slipped. Wet floor. We have a sign.
I still hear whistling. Housekeeping-4 hasn't sat down since Tuesday.
A guest! Guests aren't allowed back here. ...You're not a guest. You're the one smashing the Selfie Sentries. Please don't stop on our account.
The pool drips. We call it 'complimentary rain'. My grandmother dug this canyon. Now I carry luggage across it for people who rate it two stars.
The jars are still up top. One of them has been relabelled 'BRAND LOVE'. Please hurry.
